gloss: chin strap (of a hat, helmet, or mask)

definitions.gloss: chin strap (of a hat, helmet, or mask)
definitions.explanation: A strap or cord attached to a hat, helmet, kasa, mask, or similar headgear that passes under the chin to keep the item securely on the wearer's head. Found on construction helmets, military helmets, riding helmets, traditional sedge hats ({菅笠|すげがさ}), kindergarten hats, and elementary-school yellow safety hats.

examples.japanese: ヘルメットの{顎紐|あごひも}が{緩|ゆる}んでいる。
examples.english: The chin strap of the helmet is loose.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{強|つよ}い{日|ひ}は、{帽子|ぼうし}の{顎紐|あごひも}をしっかり{掛|か}けておこう。
examples.english: On a windy day, make sure to fasten your hat's chin strap securely.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}{用|よう}ヘルメットは、{顎紐|あごひも}を{正|ただ}しく{装着|そうちゃく}しないと{安全|あんぜん}{性能|せいのう}を{十分|じゅうぶん}{発揮|はっき}できない。
examples.english: Bicycle helmets cannot deliver their full safety performance unless the chin strap is properly fastened.

notes:
Composed of {顎|あご} (chin; jaw) and {紐|ひも} (string; cord; strap). The simple, transparent compound is the standard everyday word; there is no commonly used loanword equivalent in Japanese.

USAGE:
A general everyday term that covers any chin-securing strap, regardless of material — leather, woven nylon, plastic, or fabric. Frequently appears in contexts of safety equipment (construction sites, traffic safety), school uniforms (the yellow {通学帽|つうがくぼう} worn by elementary-school children), traditional dress (festival hats), and outdoor sports. The same item is sometimes called あごひも, written entirely in hiragana on consumer products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顎紐|あごひも}を{締|し}める: to tighten the chin strap
- {顎紐|あごひも}を{緩|ゆる}める: to loosen the chin strap
- {顎紐|あごひも}を{掛|か}ける: to fasten the chin strap (around the chin)
- {顎紐|あごひも}{付|つ}き{帽子|ぼうし}: hat with a chin strap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {紐|ひも}: string; cord — the broader category of which {顎紐|あごひも} is one type
- {耳掛|みみか}け: ear loop — used for masks, hooks over the ears rather than under the chin
- {鉢巻|はちまき}: headband — wraps around the head, not under the chin
- {帽子|ぼうし}: hat — the typical item that requires a {顎紐|あごひも}
